candidates.title: California ant war killed 15 million workers in 6 months, researchers found
candidates.excerpt: A tumultuous and deadly rivalry unfolds among five Argentine ant supercolonies in San Diego, resulting in an alarming number of fatalities. These strongly territorial ants engage in relentless battles, disregarding the 'dear enemy effect' common in territorial animals. Surprisingly, studies reveal that these colonies have reached an impasse, maintaining fixed borders even amid continuous aggression, indicating a lengthy conflict without an end in sight.

candidates.title: Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, Neha Bora Detention: Who are Special Executive Magistrates, why are they in news after SIR
candidates.excerpt: The detention of CJP activists Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, and a notice to AISA president Neha Bora, have spotlighted Special Executive Magistrates’ preventive powers amid SIR protests. The cases raise questions over procedural safeguards, peace bonds and the impact on personal liberty.

candidates.title: Big relief for Das, Ranka: CJP leaders released after 7 days; Dipke posts SRK clip
candidates.excerpt: A special executive magistrate court in Delhi reserved its order regarding the custody of CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. The police sought an extension of three days for their custody following a protest at Jantar Mantar. During the proceedings, Das and Ranka challenged the custody extension in the Delhi high court. The high court advised them to await the SEM's decision before seeking further legal remedies.
